vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ecommerce-review-analyzer
Version: 1.0.1

The ecommerce-review-analyzer skill is a legitimate tool designed to extract and analyze product reviews from Chinese e-commerce platforms (Taobao, JD, Pinduoduo). The provided Python code in SKILL.md implements basic sentiment analysis and report formatting logic without any signs of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or unauthorized access. It relies on the host environment's browser automation capabilities as declared in its metadata.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (browser-based review extraction and analysis) and do not request unrelated credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: The skill claims to extract and analyze reviews from Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo via browser automation. Requiring python3, Chinese text libraries (jieba) and doc/pdf generation tools is proportional to that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md directs browser automation and login-assisted review scraping and includes local Python analysis/report generation. It does not instruct reading unrelated files or environment variables, but it necessarily requires access to the user's logged-in browser session (cookies/auth) to scrape reviews — this is expected for the stated task but is a sensitive capability.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec. It lists pip dependencies (jieba, python-docx, fpdf2) inside SKILL.md rather than an install block — low install risk, but the agent may need to run pip at runtime which will fetch packages from PyPI.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, secrets, or config paths are requested. The only sensitive access implied is the browser automation using the user's logged-in sessions, which is appropriate for scraping authenticated review content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and does not request persistent or system-wide privileges. It does not declare modifications to other skills or agent configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for extracting and analyzing reviews, but it requires browser automation and access to your logged-in sessions to scrape reviews — that lets it read data visible in your browser (including cookies/session state). Before installing or running it: 1) confirm you trust the skill source (source/homepage unknown); 2) be aware it may run pip install at runtime to fetch dependencies; 3) avoid running it while logged into unrelated sensitive accounts or with pages that expose PII you don't want scraped; 4) ask the author how LLM analysis is performed (local/platform model vs. external API) if you need assurance that scraped data is not sent to third-party endpoints. For stricter isolation, run the tool in a controlled environment or profile dedicated to scraping the target sites.
